CONTROLS.NAME: MODE_1_OR_2
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: You must pick a video from your media. DOWN applies a motion blur effect to the video, UP uses an edge detector.

CONTROLS.NAME: color_palette
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Choose from one of 10 color palettes.

CONTROLS.NAME: invert_regime
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Stay in the same color space, but switch the direction of the palette from dark to light.

CONTROLS.NAME: color_oscillator
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When on, color palette will slowly oscillate vertically on the screen.

CONTROLS.NAME: motion_blur
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adjusts the level of motion blur. If in MODE 2 (UP), then it adjusts edge thickness.

CONTROLS.NAME: contrast
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adjusts the contrast of the underlying image or video.

CONTROLS.NAME: animation_style
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Only works in MODE 1, changes animation style. Set to bottom for none. Set to middle for diamonds. Set to top for waves.

CONTROLS.NAME: manual_animation
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Hit to create an animation pulse.
